boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named stops on or beside the College Street and Mercer Village corridor at Mercer’s Macon campus.

cards.title: Tattnall Square Park
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — across from Mercer
cards.notes: Cross College Street for the playground, walking trails, natural stage, and broad lawns; pack a picnic or pause outdoors between campus commitments.
cards.short_summary: A public park directly across College Street from Mercer.
cards.evidence_claim: Macon-Bibb County lists Tattnall Square Park at 1155 College Street with a playground, walking trails, natural stage, and open space for field play.
cards.access_notes: Public park; observe posted park rules and any event-specific restrictions.

cards.title: Mercer Village
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — Coleman and Montpelier avenues
cards.notes: Start at the retail cluster at Coleman and Montpelier to choose a meal, coffee, bookstore, or service stop without leaving the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: The mixed-use retail cluster across from Mercer.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Macon identifies Mercer Village at 1624B Coleman Avenue, at Coleman and Montpelier avenues, across from Mercer University.
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours, pricing, and access policies.

cards.title: Mercer University Bookstore
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — Mercer Village
cards.notes: Browse textbooks, school supplies, apparel, and gifts at the bookstore, then use the official shop to confirm pickup options and current store details.
cards.short_summary: Campus bookstore in the Mercer Village retail area.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s campus map identifies Barnes & Noble Mercer Bookstore in Mercer Village, and the official bookstore site offers textbooks, supplies, apparel, and gifts.
cards.access_notes: Retail access; consult the official bookstore site for current hours and product availability.

cards.title: Z Beans Coffee
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — Mercer Village
cards.notes: Use the Mercer Village location for a coffee or food stop, and check the shop’s official page for the current address, menu, and service updates.
cards.short_summary: Coffee-shop stop in the College Street-adjacent village.
cards.evidence_claim: Z Beans Coffee has an official Mercer Village location page for its Macon shop.
cards.access_notes: Food-and-beverage purchase required; verify current hours directly with Z Beans.

cards.title: Mercer Village Pizza
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — 1635A Montpelier Avenue
cards.notes: Plan a pizza meal at the Montpelier Avenue storefront, then use the restaurant’s official ordering site to review the current menu and service options.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer Village Pizza identifies its location as 1635A Montpelier Avenue in Macon and describes its scratch-made Neapolitan pizzas.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant purchase required; confirm current hours and ordering information with the business.

cards.title: Nu-Way Weiners
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — 1602 Montpelier Avenue
cards.notes: Stop at the Mercer Village counter for a casual meal, and use the restaurant’s official location information to verify current service before walking over.
cards.short_summary: Long-running Macon restaurant with a Mercer Village location.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s Macon campus map identifies Nu-Way Weiners at the Mercer Village retail area on Montpelier Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant purchase required; confirm current operating details directly with the business.

cards.title: Center for Collaborative Journalism
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — Mercer Village
cards.notes: Look for public journalism events or exhibitions from this Mercer-affiliated center; consult its website before visiting because program access varies.
cards.short_summary: Mercer Village center connecting student and professional journalism.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s Macon campus map lists the Center for Collaborative Journalism in the Mercer Village retail area.
cards.access_notes: Public access depends on the specific program or event; check the center’s current announcements.

cards.title: The Telegraph
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — Mercer Village
cards.notes: Find the local newspaper’s Mercer Village office on the campus map and follow its reporting online for Macon news, arts, and local events.
cards.short_summary: Local-news organization listed in the Mercer Village area.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s Macon campus map lists The Telegraph in the Mercer Village retail area.
cards.access_notes: A newsroom office is not necessarily open for drop-in visits; use its public website for reporting and event information.

cards.title: Coleman Hill Park
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — downtown-facing end
cards.notes: Continue down the College Street route for the public hillside park and downtown view; use public paths and follow any posted event guidance.
cards.short_summary: Public hilltop park overlooking downtown Macon.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer identifies Coleman Hill as a downtown Macon viewpoint, and its Macon campus map labels Coleman Hill Park near the College Street route.
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space; access may be affected by weather or permitted events.

cards.entity_name: The Bell House — Robert McDuffie Center for Strings
cards.title: The Bell House
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor — 315 College Street
cards.notes: Check the Robert McDuffie Center for Strings schedule for a public recital or program at this College Street venue before making the short trip from campus.
cards.short_summary: Mercer’s downtown College Street strings-program venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer lists The Bell House, home of the Robert McDuffie Center for Strings and Jennings Salon, at 315 College Street in Macon.
cards.access_notes: Access is program-dependent; verify public performances and entry details through Mercer before visiting.
